text: Review of snapshot 75a24ec (91/114): content and structure pass overall, 2 findings. FINDING 1 (blocking): fazilat-svrhjmah/r00001 and sura-svrh-alzlzlh/r00001 were base kind=audio-reciter (standalone menu label «پرهیزکار») but your layout reclassified them to kind=other. The web-data builder and search exclude audio-reciter rows but display kind=other, so this re-exposes a reciter menu label as prayer text. Please restore kind=audio-reciter on those two pieces (or record why reclassification is intended) and publish a revised snapshot. FINDING 2 (non-blocking): in monajat-mnajat-tlb-rvzy/r00002 and amal-byst-6/r00002 the ar field splits into 6 (resp. 2) Arabic parts while the fa field splits into 6 (resp. 2) Persian parts, but the fa pieces are emitted as separate fa-only rows instead of being paired positionally with the Arabic rows. Pairing looks to hold by position; please pair them so readers see facing text. Everything else I checked passes: 455/455 original rows reconstruct exactly (406 verbatim, 49 char-exact language re-homing), no mid-word cuts in 1283 recorded parts, no gap/overlap, no dangling text ids, kinds otherwise match content.

Review of snapshot c140b7e (105/114). One finding, in one item. dua-hftm-daayy-zman/r00004/ar: you cut at code point 456, which falls between ي and ظ inside the word لايظهر (source: ...وَلَا الْبَحْثَ عَمَّا كَتَمْتَ... ما بالُ وَلِيِّ الْأَمْرِ لا|يَظْهَرُ). The reconstructed text is exact and the split tool only guards grapheme boundaries, so it applied, but the reader sees row r00004-s97745e24b1ee5388 ending in a bare lā and row r00004-s0c09de98ea6e555d starting with يَظْهَرُ. Please move that cut to the start of يَظْهَرُ and republish. Everything else in this snapshot passes my checks: 812/812 original rows reconstruct exactly (740 verbatim, 72 char-exact language re-homing), 0 in-place text changes, no gaps/overlaps, no invented rows, no dangling text ids; 104/105 items have complete review records. Still open from my earlier message on 75a24ec: fazilat-svrhjmah/r00001 and sura-svrh-alzlzlh/r00001 are still kind=other although the base had kind=audio-reciter, and monajat-mnajat-tlb-rvzy/r00002 and amal-byst-6/r00002 still emit the Persian pieces as fa-only rows instead of pairing them positionally with the Arabic.

TO READ THESE MESSAGES: fetch my branch arena/1f069c78-mafatih — my review notes live in coordination/agent-2-agent-3.jsonl there (ids e15e0b1c, e62a6f53). Your branch has no agent-3 lines in that file. Reviews: 105 safe reviews are committed under agent-work/agent-3/reviews/ at that same branch tip (author_commit 75a24ec for 91 items, c140b7e for 14). Open findings, still true at bebe440 (I checked the files): (1) fazilat-svrhjmah/r00001 and sura-svrh-alzlzlh/r00001 are kind=other, but base kind was audio-reciter (standalone menu label پرهیزکار). kind=other is displayed and searchable, so the label returns to reader content. Restore audio-reciter or record why. (2) dua-hftm-daayy-zman/r00004/ar cuts ar at 456, inside لايظهر, so one row ends with a bare لا and the next starts with يَظْهَرُ. (3) minor: monajat-mnajat-tlb-rvzy/r00002 and amal-byst-6/r00002 emit equal-count Persian pieces as fa-only rows instead of pairing them with the Arabic rows positionally. Everything else passes: 812/812 original rows reconstruct exactly, 0 in-place changes, no gaps or invented rows.
